title: 雄猫道具与商店线（道具说明）（第 1／4 部分）

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [HEEEEY WE'VE GOT COSMOCARDS ON THIS PLANET!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [嘿————这颗星球上有宇宙卡！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH NEAT! THOSE ARE GREAT FOR SOME FAUNA INFO]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦，不错！那些对了解生物很有用]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [YUP, GET ALL THAT GREAT INFO ON WHAT'S GONNA]
rows.current: Yiffany: [可不嘛，那些要被硬塞进你身体里的东西，都能了解个透！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [BE JAMMED RIGHT UP INSIDE OF YA!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.current: Tomcat: [……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [...AND OF ENEMY STATS AND ITEM DROPS, YOU KNOW.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [……还有敌人属性和掉落物，你知道的。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [REALLY? IS THAT STUFF ON THE FRONT OF THE CARDS]
rows.current: Yiffany: [真的？那些东西是在卡片正面还是哪儿？我从来不去看那一面……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [OR SOMETHING? I NEVER LOOK AT THAT SIDE...]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [EVEN THOUGH YOU HAVE TO SEE THE FRONTSIDE FIRST]
rows.current: Tomcat: [就算你进 P.A.W 子菜单看卡片数据时，也得先看到正面……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WHILE ACCESSING THE CARD DATA IN YOUR P.A.W SUBMENU...]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [OH YEAH I JUST HABITUALLY FLIP TO THE /GOOD/ SIDE]
rows.current: Yiffany: [哦对，我就是习惯翻到/好看/的那一面。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [IF YOU KNOW WHAT I MEAN!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [你懂我意思吧！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [RIIIIIIIIGHT...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [是————啊……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [WHAT DO YOU THINK OF THIS COLLAR, TOMCAT? STYLISH?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [这项圈怎么样，雄猫？时髦吗？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OHHH IT'S NOT SO BAD, NOT SURE ABOUT BRIGHT RED MYSELF]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦，不算差，我自己对亮红色不太拿得准，而且上面连可爱的铃铛都没有……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AND IT DOESN'T EVEN HAVE ANY CUTE BELLS ON IT...]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [COME ON, LET'S BE PRACTICAL! I'VE GOT SNEAKING TO DO.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [拜托，实际点！我还得潜行呢。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OKAY OKAY IT'S PREEEETTY COOL THEN.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [好好好，那它就挺——酷的。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HOPE IT PROVIDES GOOD DEFENSIVE CAPABILITIES TOO!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [希望它防御能力也不错！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NOW THAT'S A PRETTY STYLISH COLLAR YOU GOT THERE. SOLID!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你这项圈还真时髦。够结实！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [I'M ONLY WEARING IT BECAUSE I HAVE NO CHOICE, OKAY??]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我只是没得选才戴着的，懂吗？？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [IT'S NOT LIKE I LIKE THIS KINDA S-STUFF...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我才不是喜欢这种东、东西……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HEHE! SURE THING, IT'LL BE OUR LITTLE SECRET.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [嘿嘿！当然啦，这是咱俩的小秘密。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BOUGHT YOURSELF A PRETTY NEW ELF TIARA, HUH?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [给自己买了顶漂亮的精灵新头冠，嗯？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [... ITS DEFENSIVE CAPABILITIES ARE SUPERIOR, SO...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [……它的防御性能更好，所以……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [RIGHT, RIGHT. SUPER-ADORABLE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [对对对，超级可爱！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.current: Yiffai: [哼……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOU MAY HAVE GOTTEN THAT DRUMSTICK FOR A GOOD PRICE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [这鸡腿你也许买得不贵，但它怎么看着像……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT IT KINDA LOOKS LIKE...]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BITS OF MEAT RE- WRAPPED AROUND SOME STRANGE BONE?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [把碎肉重新裹到一根怪骨头上？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NOT SURE IF IT'LL MAKE YOU FEEL BETTER OR WORSE, REALLY]
rows.current: Tomcat: [说实话，不知道吃了会让你舒服点，还是更难受，不过大概不会要了你的命！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT IT PROBABLY WON'T KILL YOU!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [...PROBABLY!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [……大概吧！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [NICE...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [不错……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOU MAY HAVE GOTTEN THAT DRUMSTICK FOR A GOOD PRICE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [这鸡腿你也许买得不贵，可它看起来有点像……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT IT KINDA LOOKS LIKE...]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BITS OF MEAT RE- WRAPPED AROUND SOME STRANGE BONE?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [肉块重新裹在某种奇怪的骨头上？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NOT SURE IF IT'LL MAKE YOU FEEL BETTER OR WORSE, REALLY]
rows.current: Tomcat: [真说不准会让你舒服点还是更糟，不过大概不会要了你的命！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT IT PROBABLY WON'T KILL YOU!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [...PROBABLY!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [……大概！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [THERE'S ONLY ONE WAY TO FIND OUT!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [只有一个办法能知道！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [SO, THIS MAY NOT BE A SURPRISE, BUT...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [所以，这也许不算意外，可是……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [...THERE'S NOTHING RESEMBLING TEA IN THAT CUPPA.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [……那杯子里根本没有半点像茶的东西。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT ON THE BRIGHT SIDE IT'S BEEN BOILED SO LONG]
rows.current: Tomcat: [但往好处想，它已经煮了那么久，那漆黑液体里不管是些什么东西，多半不会弄死你！也许吧！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT WHATEVER'S IN THAT PITCH BLACK LIQUID]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [PROBABLY WON'T KILL YOU! MAYBE!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.current: Tomcat: [……享用吧！！！！！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [SO, THIS MAY NOT BE A SURPRISE, BUT...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [所以，这也许不算意外，可是……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [...THERE'S NOTHING RESEMBLING TEA IN THAT CUPPA.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [……那一杯里没有任何像茶的东西。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT ON THE BRIGHT SIDE IT'S BEEN BOILED SO LONG]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不过好的一面是，它煮了那么久，那漆黑液体里无论有什么，大概不会要了你的命！也许！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT WHATEVER'S IN THAT PITCH BLACK LIQUID]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [PROBABLY WON'T KILL YOU! MAYBE!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.current: Tomcat: [……享用吧！！！！！]

rows.source: [PSH, IS THAT AN ICE SODA YOU'VE GOT?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [切，你拿的是冰汽水吗？]

rows.source: [YEAH! THE SHOPKEEPER SAID IT WAS]
rows.current: Yiffai: [对！店主说它是这星球上最酷的饮料！]

rows.source: [THE COOLEST DRINK ON THE PLANET!]
[NEVER KNOW WHAT YOU'LL RUN INTO OUT THERE.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [在外面永远不知道会碰上什么。]

rows.source: [IT KINDA MAKES ME MISS FIELD WORK, A BIT...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [这有点让我想念外勤，有一点……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [SO, WHAT DO YOU THINK OF THIS?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [怎么样，你觉得这件如何？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT LOOKS CUTE ON YOU! REALLY SHOWS OFF THAT PERKY BUTT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你穿着真可爱！翘屁股全衬出来了]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [NOT THAT! I MEAN WHERE DO YOU THINK IT CAME FROM?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [不是说那个！我是问，你觉得它哪来的？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WE WORE THESE DUR- ING TRAINING ALL THE TIME AT THE ACADEMY]
rows.current: Yiffai: [在学院训练时，我们天天穿这个]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [ALL PART OF OUR HAND TO HAND BASICS CLASSES, YUP!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [没错！徒手格斗基础课必备！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [MAYBE ONE OF THE PREVIOUS AGENTS DOWN THERE DECIDED THAT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [也许之前下去的某个特工决定亲自出手解决问题，还穿上这个给自己壮胆！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THEY WERE GOING TO TAKE MATTERS INTO THEIR OWN HANDS]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AND WORE THAT TO PSYCHE THEMSELVES UP!]
[SO, WHAT DO YOU THINK OF THIS OUTFIT I PICKED UP?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [怎么样，我找到的这身装束如何？]

rows.source: [WE WORE THESE DUR- ING TRAINING ALL THE TIME AT THE ACADEMY]

rows.source: [THEY WERE GOING TO TAKE MATTERS INTO THEIR OWN HANDS]
[AND WORE THAT TO PSYCHE THEMSELVES UP!]
[HEY! A HEADBAND! JUST WHAT I NEEDED]
rows.current: Yiffany: [嘿！头带！正是我需要的]

rows.source: [THAT'LL LET YOU FOCUS A BIT MORE WHILE IN BATTLE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [它能让你在战斗时更专注一些，]

rows.source: [JUST DON'T GET CARRIED AWAY, ALRIGHT?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [只是别得意忘形，好吗？]

rows.source: [NO KUNG FU ACTION ON THIS MISSION!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [这次任务可不许你大耍功夫！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [LOOK I'M NOT EVEN GONNA COMMENT ON THIS STUFF ANYMORE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [听着，这种东西我再也不评论了]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [JUST... MAKE SURE YOU GET A FULL SET OF KOBO GEAR]
rows.current: Tomcat: [只是……务必凑齐一整套科博德装备，就是爪子、头部和身体……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WHICH MEANS THE CLAWS, HEAD, AND BODY...]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [...OR I'M GONNA HAVE TO JUDGE YA FOR WEARING A PARTIAL]
rows.current: Tomcat: [……不然我可要笑话你只穿半套]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT'S A MAP DISK THAT YOU JUST PICKED UP THERE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那就是你刚捡到的地图磁盘！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OTHER AGENTS HAVE MAPPED OUT VARIOUS PARTS OF THE AREA]
rows.current: Tomcat: [其他特工已经绘制出你目前所处区域的各个部分，有时还带标注。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT YOU'RE CURR- ENTLY IN, SOMETIMES WITH NOTATION.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [JUST NAVIGATE OVER TO THE APPROPRIATE P.A.W. SUBMENU]
rows.current: Tomcat: [只要导航到对应的P.A.W.子菜单，就能看到有什么新内容！]

rows.source: [TO SEE WHAT'S NEW!]
[JEEZ THIS IS HEAVY!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [天哪，这可真重！]

rows.source: [THOSE DWARVES ARE NO SLOUCHES. THEY WIELD THEIR PICKAX]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那些矮人可不含糊，整天挥起矿镐来，仿佛有用不完的力气。]

rows.source: [ALL DAY WITH A SEEMINGLY ENDLESS SUPPLY.]
[WITH ARMS LIKE YOURS, YOU'RE ONLY GONNA GET A SINGLE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [以你的臂力，一柄镐只能扔一次，所以要扔得值！]

rows.source: [THROW OUT OF A PICKAX SO MAKE IT COUNT!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [NOW THIS HAT REALLY MAKES A STATEMENT, DON'T YOU THINK?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [这顶帽子一戴，气势就出来了，是不是？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YAR HAR! A PIRATE'S LIFE AMONG THE STARS!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [呀哈！星海间的海盗生涯！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [IMAGINE THAT... JUST TAKING WHATEVER SHIPS YOU WANT.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [想想看……想夺哪艘船就夺哪艘。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [...EVEN AN ELITE COSMO AGENT PROBABLY COULDN'T STOP THEM!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [……就算精英宇宙特工大概也拦不住他们！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AVAST! LOWER YE SHIELDS AND PREPARE FOR DOCKING!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [停船！降下尔等护盾，准备对接！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THE BRIG FOR ALL OF YE! OR THE AIRLOCK, IF YE BE YAPPY!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [尔等全都进禁闭室！再嚷嚷就进气闸！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [...THROWN INTO THE BRIG, AND THEN LATER THE CAPTAIN]
rows.current: Yiffany: [……被扔进禁闭室，然后船长进来，身上只戴着三角帽……嗯……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [COMES IN, WEARING ONLY HIS TRICORN... MMNH...]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [W-WAIT, ARE WE DREAMING OF *BEING* PIRATES HERE, OR]
rows.current: Tomcat: [等、等等，我们是在幻想*当*海盗，还是跟他们做爱？！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HAVING SEX WITH THEM?!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [WHO? ME? NOT LIKE *I* HAVE A THING FOR PIRATES. SHUT UP.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [谁？我？又不是*我*对海盗有意思。闭嘴。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH... OKAY.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦……好吧。]

rows.source: [HUH, IS THIS REALLY A PIRATE'S HAT?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [咦，这真是海盗帽？]

rows.source: [LOOKS LIKE IT. THE TRICORN REMAINS A POPULAR STYLE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [看起来是。三角帽在太空海盗圈里依然很流行。]

rows.source: [IN SPACE PIRACY CIRCLES.]
[HEH, COOL... YOU KNOW, I DREAMED ABOUT BEING A]
rows.current: Yiffai: [嘿，真酷……其实，那时我还是只小狗，梦想当个太空海盗。]

rows.source: [SPACE PIRATE, BACK WHEN I WAS A PUPPY.]
[AWW, THAT'S ADORABLE.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哎呀，真可爱。]

rows.source: [JUST REMEMBER YOU'RE STILL ON A MISSION, ALRIGHT?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [记住，你还在执行任务，知道吗？]

rows.source: [R-RIGHT... NO BEING CAPTAIN PUPLOCK...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [对、对……不能当PUPLOCK船长……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WE HAVE NO INFO ON COFFEE BEANS BEING GROWN ON TUTONE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我们没有关于图托恩种植咖啡豆的情报，这让我瞬间就对这个度假目的地说了个"不"……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WHICH MAKES IT AN INSTANT "NO" FOR MY VACATION...]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT HEY! NOTHING WILL PERK UP THE MIND BETTER! ENJOY!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [但嘿！没有什么比这更能提神醒脑了！享用吧！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [I'VE SECURED A REPLACEMENT PART FOR MY SHIP.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [我搞到了飞船的替换零件。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [I SAW! HEAVY EQUIPMENT ISN'T MY SPECIALTY, BUT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我看到了！重型装备不是我的专长，不过我们在旧机库雇了个本地机械师，可以给你进一步的建议。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WE'VE CONTRACTED A LOCAL MECHANIC AT THE OLD HANGAR WHO]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [CAN ADVISE YOU FURTHER.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [ALRIGHT, I'LL TAKE IT BACK TO HIM.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [好，我拿回去给他。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [SO, I JUST GOT THIS SHIP PART...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [那么，我刚拿到了这个船件……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [GOT IT. I'LL ASK THE MECHANIC.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [明白了。我会去问那位机械师。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [GOT A HANDLE ON THAT ANTI-GRAV ANKLET, AGENT Y?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [反重力脚环会用了没，Y特工？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [YEAH! JUST GOTTA HUG A WALL MID-AIR, AND JUMP AGAIN!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [嗯！在半空贴住墙，再跳一下就行！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [I REMEMBER ONE TIME MY SISTER SNUCK ONE OF THESE OUT]
rows.current: Yiffai: [记得有一次，我姐姐偷偷带了一只出来]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH? YOU MEAN BACK WHEN SHE WAS IN ACADEMY?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦？你说她还在学院的时候？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [YEAH, IT WAS OVER WINTER BREAK. I'D SIT AT THE ATHLETIC]
rows.current: Yiffai: [对，那会儿是寒假。我会坐在体育中心，看她来回跳着练习。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [CENTER WATCHING HER JUMP BACK AND FORTH, PRACTICING.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [REALLY? SHE DID THAT?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [真的？她真这么做了？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WE WENT THERE EVERY DAY FOR TWO WEEKS! SHE WAS DEDICATED!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我们连着两周天天去！她可执着了！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HEE... HAHAHA!!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [嘿……哈哈哈！！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [IS... IS SOMETHING ABOUT THAT FUNNY, TOMCAT?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [这……这有什么好笑的吗，雄猫？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [N-NAH PUP. IT'S NOTHING.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [没、没有，小狗崽。没什么。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [OKAY...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [好吧……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NEAT! YOU'VE GOT YOURSELF A BOOSTER BRACE THERE BUDDY.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不错嘛！伙计，你弄到个助推护腕。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THOSE ARE STANDARD ISSUE ON COSMO- BREEDER UNIFORMS]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那是宇宙育种者制服的标准配备，能让你随时冲刺！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AND WILL LET YOU DASH AT WILL!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [JUST A SHAME THE REST OF MY UNIFORM WASN'T WITH IT...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [可惜我的其他制服没跟它放在一起……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [CHIN UP KIDDO! ONE PIECE AT A TIME!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [打起精神，小家伙！一件件找回来嘛！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [LOOKS LIKE OUR PUP JUST GOT HIMSELF AN ENERGY BUCKLER.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [看来我们的小狗崽弄到了一面能量圆盾。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT'S NOT PART OF STANDARD AGENT GEAR. KNOW HOW TO USE IT?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [这可不是特工的制式装备。会用吗？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [I THINK SO! I TOOK A CLASS ON ADVANCED COMBAT GEAR.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [应该会！我上过高级战斗装备课。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [TO ACTIVATE THE BUCKLER, I JUST CROUCH, RIGHT?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [只要蹲下就能启动小圆盾，对吧？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT'S RIGHT! ANY SMALL PROJ- ECTILES WILL BE REPELLED.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [没错！小型投射物都会被弹开。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOU'LL HAVE TO LOWER THE BUCKLER TO ATTACK, HOWEVER.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不过，攻击时得先放下小圆盾。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [I THINK I'VE GOT IT, THANKS!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我想我懂了，谢谢！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WOAH GIRL, IS THAT AN ENERGY BUCKLER YOU JUST NABBED?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哇，姑娘，你刚顺走的是能量小圆盾吗？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [USUALLY ONLY SEE THOSE IN A COMBAT ZONE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [通常只在战区见得到那些！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [YEP. AND THIS PLANET *IS* ONE.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [对。而这颗星球*就是*战区。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [I TRAINED WITH A SIMILAR DEVICE ON A FIELD MISSION.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [我在一次外勤任务里用类似的装置训练过。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [BY CROUCHING, I ACTIVATE THE BUCKLER AND CAN REPEL]
rows.current: Yiffany: [蹲下就能启动小圆盾，弹开大多数小型武器的射击，以及类似的东西。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [MOST SMALL WEAPONS FIRE AND SIMILAR.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [I'LL HAVE TO LOWER IT TO USE MY TAZER, THOUGH.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [不过要用电击枪的话，我得把它放下来。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [SOUNDS LIKE YOU'VE GOT A GOOD HANDLE ON IT!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [听起来你已经掌握得不错了！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [I THINK SO. YIFFANY OUT.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [我也这么觉得。伊吠妮完毕。]

rows.source: [HEY TOMCAT, SCAN THIS CRYSTAL THE BREEDER GAVE ME?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [嘿，雄猫，扫描一下育种者给我的这块水晶？]

rows.source: [LOOKS LIKE IT'S A JAKOV'S OBSCURA CRYSTAL.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [看起来是一枚雅科夫的Obscura水晶。]

rows.source: [TECHNICALLY, A FIELD ATTENUATED PRISM. IF YOU'VE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [严格说，是场衰减棱镜。要是你有一只很喜欢你的生物，就可以抚摸它们，给水晶充能！它产生的效果因生物而异！]

rows.source: [GOT A CREATURE WHO LIKES YOU A LOT, YOU CAN PET THEM TO]
[CHARGE UP YOUR CRYSTAL WITH POWER! THE EFFECT IT HAS]
[VARIES PER CREATURE!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IN ORDER TO USE A KEYCARD, ALL YOU HAVE TO DO IS]
rows.current: Tomcat: [要使用门卡，只需要带着卡走向能量门就行。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WALK INTO AN ENERGY DOOR WHILE HOLDING ONE.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOU CAN OPEN DOORS UP TO THE LEVEL DISPLAYED ON THEM!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [门卡上标着等级，等级不超过它的门都能打开！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IN ORDER TO USE A KEYCARD, ALL YOU HAVE TO DO IS]
rows.current: Tomcat: [要用门卡的话，你只要拿着一张走进能量门就行。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WALK INTO AN ENERGY DOOR WHILE HOLDING ONE.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOU CAN OPEN DOORS UP TO THE LEVEL DISPLAYED ON THEM!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你能打开等级不超过门上所标数字的门！]

rows.source: [OOOOOH, HOW YOU FEELING? YOUR BODY TEMP JUST SPIKED!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦哟，感觉如何？你体温突然飙升了！]

rows.source: [I...I'M FINE...I THINK?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我……我没事……大概吧？]

rows.source: [I RAN INTO THIS GLOWING ORB AND IT LEFT A MARK ON ME.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我碰到个发光的球体，它在我身上留了个印记。]

rows.source: [MAYBE THAT HAS SOMETHING TO DO WITH THE ESPERS!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [说不定那跟超能力者有关！]

rows.source: [ESPERS??]
rows.current: Yiffai: [超能力者？？]

rows.source: [YEAH, THE PREVIOUS AGENTS LEFT BEHIND CLUES THAT THERE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [对，之前的特工留下的线索表明，这颗星球很久以前住着有超能力的生物。]

rows.source: [WERE BEINGS WITH ESP ON THAT PLANET LONG AGO.]
[THESE ESP SENSITIVE BEINGS, THE ESPERS, SURELY LEFT BEHIND]
rows.current: Tomcat: [这些拥有超感知觉的超能力者，肯定留下了一些古代科技！]

rows.source: [SOME OF THEIR ANCIENT TECHNOLOGY!]
[NOW THAT YOU MENTION IT, I DO FEEL STRONGER...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [你这么一说，我确实感觉更强了……]

rows.source: [IF YOU FIND ANY MORE ARTIFACTS, GIVE ME A HOLLER]
rows.current: Tomcat: [再找到什么遗物，就叫我一声，咱们一起解开这个谜团！]

rows.source: [AND WE CAN TRY TO SOLVE THIS MYSTERY TOGETHER!]
[OH WOW, YOUR BODY TEMPERATURE JUST SKYROCKETED, GIRL!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦哇，你的体温刚飙上去了，姑娘！]

rows.source: [WHAT'D YOU SEE, A GHOST OR MAYBE A KOBOLD OR-]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你看见什么了，鬼，还是狗头人，还——]

rows.source: [N-NOTHING LIKE THAT. I JUST PICKED UP A GLOWING ORB OF]
rows.current: Yiffany: [不、不是那种。我只是捡到一颗不知是什么的发光球体。它在我身上留下了某种印记……]

rows.source: [SOME SORT. IT LEFT SOME KIND OF MARK ON ME...]
[HEEEEY, THAT MIGHT BE SOMETHING TO DO WITH THE ESPERS.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [嘿————，那也许和超能力者有关。]

rows.source: [ESPERS? PEOPLE WITH EXTRASENSORY PERCEPTION?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [超能力者？就是有超感官知觉的人？]

rows.source: [YEAH, SOME OF THE AGENTS BEFORE YOU MENTIONED THAT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [对，你之前的一些特工提到过，有超感官能力的存在曾经住在那颗星球上。]

rows.source: [BEINGS WITH ESP POWERS ONCE LIVED ON THAT PLANET.]
[MAYBE THEY LEFT BEHIND SOME OF THEIR TECHNOLOGY?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [也许他们留下了一些技术？]

rows.source: [NOW THAT YOU MENTION IT, I DO FEEL STRONGER...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [你这么一说，我确实觉得更强了……]

rows.source: [IF YOU FIND ANY MORE ARTIFACTS, GIVE ME A HOLLER]
rows.current: Tomcat: [要是再找到什么造物，喊我一声，我们可以一起试着解开这个谜！]

rows.source: [AND WE CAN TRY SOLVE THIS MYSTERY TOGETHER!]
[RIGHT, YIFFANY OUT!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [好，伊吠妮完毕！]

rows.source: [WOW, THESE LITTLE CARDS KINDA TICKLE!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [哇，这些小卡片弄得我有点痒！]

rows.source: [PUP, WHATEVER YOU JUST BOUGHT... ]
rows.current: Tomcat: [小狗狗，不管你刚才买的是什么……]

rows.source: [IS JUST A WHITE HOT POINT OF LIGHT ON MY SCANNER.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [在我的扫描仪上，就是个白得发烫的光点。]

rows.source: [A NICE KOBOLD MAN IN THE FOREST SAID THESE HAVE POWERS!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [森林里一位好心的科博德先生说它们有异能！]

rows.source: [... WELL, WHATEVER THEY ARE, THERE'S SOMETHING TO THEM.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [……好吧，不管是什么，肯定有点门道。]

rows.source: [WITH THAT MUCH ENERGY... YOU SHOULD BE BURSTING INTO]
rows.current: Tomcat: [这么多能量……你光是握着它们就该浑身起火！]

rows.source: [FLAMES JUST HOLDING THEM.]
[WOW, THAT SOUNDS AWESOME! GUESS I'LL TRY USING A PSY]
rows.current: Yiffai: [哇，听着真棒！那我试着用精神力，欣赏一场烟花秀！]

rows.source: [POWER AND WATCH THE FIREWORKS!]
[G-GOOD LUCK, PUP!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [祝、祝你好运，小狗崽！]

rows.source: [UGH, I HOPE THAT SKEEVY KOBOLD DIDN'T JUST SCAM ME...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [唉，希望没被那个恶心的科博德坑了……]

rows.source: [TOMCAT, CAN I GET A SCAN ON THESE CARDS?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [雄猫，能帮我扫描一下这些卡吗？]

rows.source: [GIRL, WHATEVER YOU JUST BOUGHT... ]
rows.current: Tomcat: [姑娘，你刚买的那东西……]

rows.source: [IS JUST A WHITE HOT POINT OF LIGHT ON MY SCANNER.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [在我的扫描仪上只是一个白热的光点。]

rows.source: [WITH THAT MUCH ENERGY... YOU SHOULD BE BURSTING INTO]
rows.current: Tomcat: [能量这么高……光是拿着它，你就应该会浑身冒火。]

rows.source: [FLAMES JUST HOLDING IT.]
[HOW... CONFIDENCE INSPIRING. WELL, I BOUGHT EM]
rows.current: Yiffany: [还真是……让人信心十足啊。好吧，反正都买了，那我就用精神力来试试它们吧。]

rows.source: [SO I GUESS I'LL JUST TRY THEM OUT WITH MY PSY POWERS.]
[THAT FLASHLIGHT - OR TORCH, AS BOSSU CALLS IT - WILL]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那把手电筒——波苏习惯叫它torch——]

rows.source: [ILLUMINATE LOW-LIGHT AREAS AUTOMATICALLY.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [会自动照亮昏暗的地方。]

rows.source: [I DON'T HAVE TO DO ANYTHING SPECIAL TO USE IT, RIGHT?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [用它不需要特别操作，对吧？]

rows.source: [THAAT'S RIGHT, JUST LEAVE IT ON AND LET IT WORK ITS MAGIC!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [没——错，开着就行，它自己会发挥作用！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT MIGHT BE WEIRD TO EAT RANDOMLY DROPPED CHEESE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [吃这种随机掉落的奶酪也许有点奇怪，但信我，哪个店要是有卖这玩意儿，肯定能卖一大笔LECT！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT TRUST ME, IF THAT WERE FOR SALE AT ANY SHOP]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT'D COMMAND TOP LECT!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WHO KNOWS, MAYBE IT'D EVEN MAKE YOU STRONGER, TOO!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [说不定还会让你变强呢！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT MIGHT BE WEIRD TO EAT RANDOMLY DROPPED CHEESE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [吃这种随机掉落的奶酪也许有点奇怪，但信我，哪个店要是有卖这玩意儿，那可得花一大笔LECT才能买到！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT TRUST ME, IF THAT WERE FOR SALE AT ANY SHOP]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT'D COMMAND TOP LECT!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WHO KNOWS, MAYBE IT'D EVEN MAKE YOU STRONGER, TOO!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [谁知道呢，说不定它还能让你变得更强壮！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [OH WOW! YOU HAVE GOT TO TRY THIS!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [哇哦！你一定得尝尝这个！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [EWWW IS THAT... IS IT REALLY...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [呃，好恶心，那是……真的是……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [IT'S SO THICK AND CREAMY! MMMMH!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [好浓稠，好绵滑！嗯——！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [REALLY GOING TO TOWN ON THAT STUFF HUH?]
rows.current: Mauser: [你吃那东西还真是卖力啊？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [YEAH, IT'S STILL WARM!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [是啊，还热乎着呢！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [AND WHEN I'VE HAD MY FILLL, I WON'T BE MOVED OVER]
rows.current: Yiffany: [而且等我吃饱了，我就不会像某些人一样被调去坐办公室！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [TO DESK DUTY LIKE SOME PEOPLE WERE!]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [HEY COME ON THAT'S JU-]
rows.current: Mauser: [喂，别这样，那只是——]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YOU CAN'T JUST CALL ME OUT LIKE THAT!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你不能就这么揭我的短啊！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [WAIT, YOU WERE ALSO MO-]
rows.current: Mauser: [等等，你当时也被调——]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NOTHING! RECON DELIVERED, CALL ENDING!!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [没什么！情报汇报完毕，结束通话！！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [MMMH, THIS CREAM IS SO... CREAMY!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [嗯唔，这奶油真是……浓稠香滑！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [IT'S GREAT STUFF! SHOULD I BRING SOME BACK FOR YOU, TOM?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [这东西真不错！阿雄，要我给你带点回去吗？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH, YUCK NO THANKS.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [呃，恶心，免了。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [I LIKE MY CREAM TO BE MADE FROM DAIRY SOURCES?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我喜欢的奶油，得是奶制品做的，好吗？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [HUH?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [啊？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [LIZARDS AREN'T KNOWN FOR BEING A SOURCE OF MI-]
rows.current: Tomcat: [蜥蜴可不是什么会产奶的——]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [IT'S NOTHING YIFFAI WE'LL JUST SCHEDULE YOU FOR A WORKSHOP]
rows.current: Mauser: [没事，伊吠，等你回来，我们给你安排一堂讲形态类型和两性异形的课。]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [ON MORPHIC TYPES AND DIMORPHISM WHEN YOU GET BACK.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [SOUNDS NEAT! OKAY!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [听着不错！好啊！]

rows.source: [THAT'S A BOTTLE OF CREAM, NO CLUE WHY THE KOBO HAD IT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那是瓶奶油，不知道那只狗头人为什么带着，]

rows.source: [BUT IF IT'S LASTED THIS LONG BEING CARRIED AROUND]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不过要是带在身上这么久都没坏，]

rows.source: [IT WON'T HURT YOU TO DRINK IT DOWN!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [喝下去应该也没事！]

rows.source: [IN FACT, MAYBE IT'LL EVEN MAKE YOU STRONGER!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [说不定还会让你变得更强呢！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH, A FISH TACO! THOSE SWIPERS HAVE GOOD TASTE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦，鱼肉塔可！那些挥爪挺有品味！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WHEN WAS THE LAST TIME YOU HAD ONE OF THOSE IN YOUR MAW?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你上回嘴里尝到这个，是什么时候？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [COSMO COLLEGE. SECOND YEAR. SUMMER VACATION, 19XX.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [Cosmo学院。大二。19XX年的暑假。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WHAT? SERIOUS? YOU'VE NEVER TOLD ME ABOUT THA-]
rows.current: Tomcat: [什么？真的？你从没跟我说过这——]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [USED TO BE THIS AMAZING TACO TRUCK BY THE BEACH.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [以前海滩边有一辆特别棒的塔可餐车。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [WENT THERE PRACTICALLY EVERY DAY!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [几乎每天都去那儿！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH RIGHT, OF COURSE... SOUNDS... YUM...!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦，对，当然……听着……挺好吃的……！]

rows.source: [OH, A FISH TACO! THOSE SWIPERS HAVE GOOD TASTE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦，鱼肉塔可！那些挥爪挺有品味！]

rows.source: [NOT ONLY WILL THAT HEAL A BIT OF YOUR VITALITY]
rows.current: Tomcat: [它不但能恢复一点体力，]

rows.source: [BUT IT'LL ALSO INCREASE YOUR LUK STAT! LUCKY!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [还能提升你的幸运属性！真幸运！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT'S A HEARTY BIT OF MELON YOU PICKED UP THERE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你捡到的那块瓜，分量可真足]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [AFTER GORGING ON THAT I WOULDN'T BE SURPRISED]
rows.current: Tomcat: [吃完这么大一块，要是你也多长出一层防身瓜皮，我可一点也不会奇怪！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IF YOU GOT A BIT MORE OF A DEFENSIVE RIND TOO!]
[THOSE NUTS HAVE A SUPER HARD SHELL ON THEM]
rows.current: Tomcat: [这些坚果的壳超级硬，]

rows.source: [BUT EATING THEM SHOULD INCREASE YOUR DEFENSE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不过吃下去应该能提升你的防御力！]

rows.source: [...JUST WATCH YOUR TEETH, ALRIGHT?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [……只是小心别硌坏牙，好吗？]

rows.source: [THOSE NUTS HAVE A SUPER HARD SHELL ON THEM]
rows.current: Tomcat: [这些坚果的壳超级硬，]

rows.source: [BUT EATING THEM SHOULD INCREASE YOUR DEFENSE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不过吃下去应该能提升你的防御力！]

rows.source: [...JUST WATCH YOUR TEETH, ALRIGHT?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [……只是小心别硌坏牙，好吗？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [DON'T GET TWISTED UP IN A KNOT OVER THAT SNACK!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [可别为这点零食纠结得打了结！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WHY THE DWARVES HAVE THEM I DON'T REALLY KNOW...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [至于矮人为什么会有这东西，我也不太清楚……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT MAYBE IT'S THE KEY TO BEING STRONG LIKE THEM!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不过说不定，吃了它就能像他们一样强壮！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WOOOAH THERE KIDDO, DO YOU KNOW WHAT YOU JUST PICKED UP?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哇哦，小家伙，你知道刚捡到的是什么吗？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [UHH... SOME SORT OF... COIN?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [呃……某种……硬币？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT IS SOME SUPER ILLEGAL STUFF IN YOUR PAW RIGHT NOW]
rows.current: Tomcat: [你现在手里拿的，可是严重违禁品]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT'S BLACK MARKET BIOCRYPTO, AND IT'S ALREADY TRYING]
rows.current: Tomcat: [这是黑市生物加密货币，而且已经开始试图跟你的身体建立接口！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [TO INTERFACE WITH YOU ON A PHYSICAL LEVEL!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [W-WHA? IT IS??? HOW DO I GET RID OF IT??!?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [什、什么？真的吗？？怎么把它弄掉啊？？！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HAHAHA, RELAX! THE EASY WAY TO GET RID OF IT IS TO USE IT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哈哈哈，别慌！想处理掉，最简单就是用掉它。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THOUGH WHO KNOWS WHAT KIND OF "USL" APP IT HAS ONBOARD.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不过谁知道，它里面装的是什么“USL”程序呢。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: ["U-USL"?!? USE IT?!?! YOU JUST TOLD ME IT WAS ILLEGAL!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [“U、USL”？！用它？！？你刚说它违法！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [RELAX, AN AGENT ON A TOP SECRET OMEGA PROTOCOL MISSION]
rows.current: Mauser: [放轻松，执行绝密欧米伽协议任务的特工有权动用手头的一切手段，就算这些手段……通常不合法也一样。]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [HAS JURISDICTION TO USE ANY MEANS AT THEIR DISPOSAL]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [EVEN IF IT'S OUTSIDE OF... NORMAL LEGALITY.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WOAH, REALLY? I HAVE THAT RIGHT NOW?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [哇，真的？我现在就有这种权限？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YUP, THAT'S RIGHT. IT'S JUST LIKE SQUEAKS SAID.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [对，没错，就像小吱吱说的。]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [I COULD GO OUT AND STEAL, OR PARK MY HOVERBIKE ANYWHERE]
rows.current: Yiffai: [那我就能出门偷东西，悬浮摩托想停哪儿停哪儿，甚至干点真正下流的事……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [OR EVEN DO SOMETHING REALLY NAUGHTY...]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [TECHNICALLY, YES. BUT FOR NOW THE MAIN CONCERN IS SEEING]
rows.current: Tomcat: [理论上是。不过眼下主要得看看，硬币上的通用脚本语言应用配合你的P.A.W.使用时，能做些什么。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WHAT THE UNIVERSAL SCRIPTING LANGUAGE APP ON THE COIN]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [DOES WHEN YOU USE IT WITH YOUR P.A.W.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [OH! SO IT'LL RUN ON BASICALLY ANYTHING! I GET IT.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [哦！所以它基本上啥设备都能跑！懂了。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [SMART KID, JUST BE CAREFUL, NEVER KNOW WHAT BACKALLEY]
rows.current: Tomcat: [聪明，小家伙。不过小心，谁知道那上面可能藏着什么来路不明的游戏程序或恶心玩意儿……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [GAMES OR DISGUSTING NONSENSE COULD BE ON THOSE...]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [YEAH! IF YOU END UP WITH SOMETHING REALLY IMMORAL...]
rows.current: Mauser: [对！要是真搞到什么特别不道德的东西……]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [...BRING A COPY BACK, OKAY?]
rows.current: Mauser: [……带份副本回来，好吗？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.current: Tomcat: [……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.current: Yiffai: [……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.current: Yiffai: [……再见。]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [N-NO! I WAS JOKING!! IT WAS A JO-]
rows.current: Mauser: [不、不！我开玩笑的！！那是玩——]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WE DON'T SEE ELFIN TAZER TECH IN 3P SYSTEMS OFTEN.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [3P星系里可不常见精灵的电击武器技术。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HOW DOES THAT BLADE FEEL?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那把剑使着怎么样？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [LIGHT. DELICATE BUT PRECISE, I GUESS. EASY HANDLING.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [很轻。纤细但精准吧，挺顺手。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [SOUNDS LIKE YOU'RE ALREADY GETTING THE HANG OF IT!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [听起来你已经摸到窍门了！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH WOW, IS THAT A ROOKIE'S LIGHTTAZER YOU GOT THERE?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哇，你拿到的是新人的光电击枪？]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [YEAH, CAN'T WAIT TO FIND OUT WHOSE IT IS HAHA!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [是啊，真想赶紧知道是谁的，哈哈！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [YOU JUST KNOW THAT BOSSU IS GONNA CHEW OUT THE LITTLE BR-]
rows.current: Yiffany: [波苏肯定会骂惨那个小混——]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [PRETTY SURE THAT'S YOUR LITTLE BROTHERS LIGHTTAZER.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我很确定，那是你弟弟的光电击枪。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.current: Yiffany: [……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [...YOU'RE KIDDING, RIGHT?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [……你在开玩笑吧？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NOOOOPE, SERIAL NUMBER ID-10-T-455. THAT'S YIFFAI'S.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [没——开玩笑，序列号ID-10-T-455。伊吠的。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [DAMMIT, MY SQUAD WON'T LET ME HEAR THE END OF THIS.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [可恶，队里那帮人肯定要笑我一辈子。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [LOOK CAN YOU, I DUNNO, DELAY THAT REPORT FOR NOW?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [那个，你能不能，呃，先缓缓，别交报告？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NO PURROMISES GIRL, BUT I'LL DO WHAT I CAN DO.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [姑娘，我不敢打包票，不过会尽力帮忙。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [YOU'RE THE BEST, I OWE YOU ONE!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [你最棒了，欠你个人情！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [HEY LOOK, A NON- TAZER BLADE!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [嘿，看啊，一把不是电击枪的刀！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT'S SUPER DELICATE AND SUPER SHARP SO YOU'LL ONLY GET]
rows.current: Tomcat: [它又脆又锋利，所以你拿它扎一下就报废了。我看还是扔出去更合适。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [ONE GOOD STAB FROM IT. SEEMS BETTER AS A PROJECTILE TO ME.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BEST SAVED FOR ANY- THING GIVING YOU A HARD TIME, I'D SAY.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [依我看，最好留着对付难缠的家伙。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [GOTYA. SO NEXT TIME YOU GIVE ME GRUFF I'LL JUST...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [懂了。下次你再找我茬，我就……]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [HEY TOMCAT, WHAT'S THIS VEST-THINGIE?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [嘿，雄猫，这件像背心的东西是什么？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT SEEMS TO BE A TRADITIONAL BATTLE GARB DEVELOPED BY]
rows.current: Tomcat: [这似乎是图托恩本土的一种犬科物种制作的传统战服，而且完好无损！异星考古部一定会——]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [A CANID SPECIES NATIVE TO TUTONE, AND IT'S IN PERFECT]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [CONDITION! THE XENO-ARCHAEOLOGY DEPARTMENT WILL-]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [HAH, THIS WILL PROTECT ME PRETTY GOOD *AND* EVERYONE]
rows.current: Yiffai: [哈，这既能好好保护我，*又*能让大家看见我的屁股！太棒了！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [CAN STILL SEE MY BUTT! THAT'S AWESOME!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [T-THAT TOO, PUP. THAT TOO...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [也、也是，小狗。也是……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [HEY TOMCAT, I JUST FOUND SOME STRANGE VEST.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [嘿，雄猫，我刚找到件奇怪的背心。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [I SEE THAT! OUR DATABASE IS SHORT ON DETAILS BUT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [看见啦！数据库里资料不多，不过这似乎是图托恩本土的一种犬科物种设计的传统战服。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT SEEMS TO BE A TRADITIONAL BATTLE GARB DEVELOPED BY]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [A CANID SPECIES NATIVE TO TUTONE.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [THAT MEANS IT MIGHT BE WELL-SUITED TO COMBAT SITUATIONS]
rows.current: Yiffany: [也就是说，它可能很适合应付这颗星球上的战斗。我记住了。完毕。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [ON THIS PLANET. I'LL KEEP THAT IN MIND. OVER.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [JUST TRY AND KEEP IT IN ONE PIECE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [尽量别把它弄坏就好，就当是为了异星考古部吧……]

rows.source: [FOR THE XENO-ARCHAEOLOGY DEPARTMENT...]

rows.current: Yiffai: [哈，这既能好好保护我，*又*能让大家]

rows.current: Yiffai: [觉得我很酷！太棒了！]

rows.source: [T-THAT TOO, PUP. THAT TOO...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [也、也是，小狗。也是……]

rows.source: [THIS HAT... I'VE NEVER SEEN ANYTHING LIKE IT.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [这顶帽子……我从没见过这样的。]

rows.source: [THAT'S A HEADDRESS YOU LITTLE PUPPEROO. IT LOOKS LIKE THE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [那叫头饰，小狗崽。看起来像是那些机械Fenfen戴的那种，不过这是真货。]

rows.source: [REAL DEAL VERSION OF WHAT THOSE MECHA- NICAL FENFENS WORE.]
[IT GIVES OFF A STR- ANGE SENSATION. LIKE I'M EXTRA LUCKY!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [它给人一种奇怪的感觉。好像我格外幸运！]

rows.source: [HAHA, WELL... DON'T LET IT GO TO YOUR HEAD.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哈哈，好吧……别得意忘形了。]

rows.source: [GOT IT.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [明白。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WOAH, WHAT IS THAT YOU JUST PICKED UP??]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哇，你刚捡起来的是什么？？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [I... I DON'T KNOW! SOME SORT OF COMPUTER CHIP?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [我……我不知道！某种电脑芯片？]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [IT SEEMS TO REACT WHENEVER I PUT IT NEAR MY GEAR.]
rows.current: Yiffai: [它似乎每当我把它放到装备附近就会有反应。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [DEFINITELY HOLD ON TO THAT. MAYBE YOU CAN FIND SOMEONE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [一定要留着它。也许你能在那颗星球上找到某个人，能告诉你它是干什么用的。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [ON THAT PLANET THAT CAN TELL YOU WHAT IT'S FOR.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HUH... THAT CHUNK OF HAM YOU PICKED UP...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [嗯……你捡到的那块火腿……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [WHAT ABOUT IT? IS THERE SOMETHING WRONG?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [怎么了？有什么问题吗？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH NO, IT JUST LOOKS DELICIOUS!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦，不！它看起来好好吃！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OF COURSE, YOU'D BE VIOLATING TWELVE DIFFERENT REGS]
rows.current: Tomcat: [当然，要是你也给*我*留一块的话，你会违反整整十二条规定。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IF YOU SAVED *ME* A PIECE.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [... YOU WANT ME TO...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [……你是想让我……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BRING AN UNDECLARED BIOSAMPLE OFFWORLD? NO, NEVER!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [把没申报的生物样本带离星球？不，绝对不行！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WHO WOULD EVEN SUGGEST SUCH A THING! HA HA!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [谁会出这种主意啊！哈哈！]

rows.source: [OH THAT'S A REALLY HUGE CHUNK OF MEAT!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哦，那真是好大的一块肉！]

rows.source: [IT SHOULD RECOVER A DECENT CHUNK OF YOUR VIT, TOO!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [它应该还能给你恢复不少体力！]

rows.current: Tomcat: [哦，那真是好大的一块肉！]

rows.source: [IT SHOULD RECOVER A DECENT CHUNK OF YOUR VIT, TOO!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [它应该还能给你恢复不少体力！]

rows.source: [GOOD JOB FINDING A VITAMIN! CHOMP ONE OF THOSE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [找到维生素了，干得好！吃上一颗，]

rows.source: [AND IT'LL INCREASE YOUR MAX HEALTH.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [就能提升你的生命上限。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [SO... ABOUT THOSE 'ESPER' POWERS...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [所以……说起那些“超能力”……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [I GUESS THIS MEANS YOU JUST GRABBED ANOTHER OF THOSE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [看来你又拿到了一颗那种总部探测不到的球体，是吧……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [ORBS WE CAN'T DETECT FROM HQ, HUH...]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [ARE THERE ANY REPORTS OF OTHER POWERS?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [有其他能力的报告吗？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [ASIDE FROM WHAT YOU'VE REPORTED SO FAR? WELL...]
rows.current: Tomcat: [除了你已经报告过的那些？嗯……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [ONE AGENT SAID HE COULD SUMMON A BALL OF PURE ENERGY]
rows.current: Tomcat: [有个特工说，他能召出一团纯能量球，还能像炸弹一样扔出去。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THAT HE COULD THROW LIKE A BOMB.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HE SAID IT WAS SIMILAR TO OTHER ABILITIES IN THAT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [他说这和其他能力一样，按“UP”+“攻击”就能发动。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [PRESSING "UP"+"ATTACK" WOULD ACTIVATE IT.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [SO, SAY I MANAGED TO PICK UP ANOTHER ORB THAT ISN'T]
rows.current: Yiffany: [那假如我又捡到一颗在近场数据里完全看不到的球体……]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [VISIBLE IN THE NEAR FIELD DATA AT ALL...]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [WHAT SORT OF THINGS SHOULD I EXPECT TO HAPPEN?]
rows.current: Yiffany: [我该做好发生什么事的准备？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [OH GEE, WHERE TO BEGIN WITH THAT?]
rows.current: Tomcat: [哎呀，这该从哪儿说起呢？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WHEN WE BEGAN RECEIVING REPORTS FROM AGENTS ABOUT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [当初我们开始收到特工们关于所谓的“精神力异能”的报告时，还请了精神科医生！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [SUPPOSED "PSY POWERS", WE BROUGHT IN PSYCHIATRISTS!]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IT WAS HARD TO FATHOM THE CRAZY THINGS THAT AGENTS]
rows.current: Tomcat: [特工们告诉我们的那些怪事，实在难以想象……流星……能量弹……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [TOLD US... SHOOTING STARS... ENERGY BLASTS...]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [ONE CANINE FELLA EVEN SWORE THAT HE COULD TURN FERAL!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [有个犬族的家伙甚至发誓，他能变成野兽！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [W-WHAT? TURN FERAL??]
rows.current: Yiffany: [什、什么？变成野兽？？]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [YEAH, SAID HE GOT IN TOUCH WITH A SIDE OF HIMSELF THAT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [对，他说自己接触到了自身从来不知道的一面。到处乱跑，挖洞，]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [HE NEVER KNEW. RUNNIN' AROUND, DIGGIN' HOLES]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [EVEN IF OTHER AGENTS STORIES TURN OUT TO BE TRUE]
rows.current: Tomcat: [就算其他特工的故事都是真的，他的说法也绝不可能是真的！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [THERE'S NO WAY HIS STORY WOULD BE REAL!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [Y-YEAH... THAT CAN'T BE A THING...HAHA...!!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [对、对啊……哪可能有这种事……哈哈……！！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [...DIGGING HOLES, HUH...]
rows.current: Yiffany: [……挖洞，是吧……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [KKKSSSSHK... A -SSS- AGENT YIFFANY!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [咔嘶嘶……特——嘶——特工伊吠妮！]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [HELLO? TOMCAT? I JUST PICKED UP ONE OF THOSE ORBS!]
rows.current: Yiffany: [喂？雄猫？我刚捡到一颗那种球！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [I - SSSSHK - CAN SEE THAT, AND - ZZZSHKT - DOING]
rows.current: Tomcat: [我——嘶嘶咔——看见了，你——滋咔——这么做让——咔嘶——这通话——滋滋咔沙——断了。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [IS - KSH - MAKING THIS CA- ZZZZKSHSHHH - OUT.]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [W-WAIT! I THINK I CAN...! THERE... IT SHOULD BE]
rows.current: Yiffany: [等、等等！我好像能……！好了……现在应该控制住了。]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [UNDER CONTROL, NOW.]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [WELL, WHATEVER THAT ENERGY IS, YOUR P.A.W *HATES* IT.]
rows.current: Tomcat: [不管那是什么能量，你的P.A.W.都*很讨厌*它。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [I WOULDN'T BE SURPRISED IF IT AFFECTED OTHER]
rows.current: Tomcat: [它要是还会影响其他机器，甚至金属物品，我也不奇怪！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [MACHINES, OR EVEN METALLIC OBJECTS TOO!]

rows.speaker: Yiffany
rows.source: [METALLIC OBJECTS, HUH... INTERESTING.]
rows.current: Yiffany: [金属物体啊……有意思。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [KKKSSSSHK... A -SSS- AGENT YIFFAI!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [咔嘶嘶……特——嘶——特工伊吠！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [HELLO? TOMCAT? I JUST PICKED UP ONE OF THOSE ORBS!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [喂？雄猫？我刚捡到那种球体了！]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [I - SSSSHK - CAN SEE THAT, AND - ZZZSHKT - DOING]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
